summary: Completed testing of BidVex Admin Panel Enhancement - Phase 1: Admin-Created Accounts. All 16 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: Admin User Management page loads correctly with Create New User button, dialog with all required fields (Account Type, Full Name, Email, Phone, Admin Verified toggle), and user list with Verify buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/admin/users/create correctly generates secure 12-char temp password with lowercase, uppercase, digit, and special char
Admin-created users have password_reset_required = true flag set correctly
Login returns 403 with PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED code and reset_token for admin-created users
POST /api/auth/force-reset-password correctly validates token, updates password, clears flag
After password reset, user can login normally with new password
Audit logs are created for admin_create_user, admin_verify_user, and force_password_reset_completed actions
Non-admin users correctly blocked from creating accounts (403)
Short passwords (<8 chars) correctly rejected during force reset
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ prefixed users created during testing for validation
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin-Created Accounts feature fully implemented and tested. Admin can create users via POST /api/admin/users/create, users get temp password and must reset on first login via /api/auth/force-reset-password. Admin can toggle admin_verified badge via PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/admin-verify. All audit logs working.
